notes.title: A Major Patch is Available Now, Added Five New Language Options
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ywhgqnsaIQo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]5 new supported language for Steam Edition[/h2]
Xuan-Yuan Sword VII added 5 new supported languages on Steam, including Russian, German, Spanish, Japanese, and Korean. And there’s also a free demo available on the Steam store page now. 
Softstar Entertainment also declared that the PS4 edition for SIEE and SIEA will also support Russian, German, Spanish after worldwide release. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/a2ab142216aafbc55efc345e18f2431eb545aa5f.jpg[/img]
[i] the New plot supports Chinese Dubbing[/i]


[h2]New Challenge: A beast of peril falling from the sky[/h2]

Red skin along with a blank face has six feet and a pair of huge wings on its back. Can't tell it is a bird or a beast. When it spread the wings, you can barely see the sky. And beware of the wing buffet that can generate a strong gale.
Using “Guard Stone” to fast travel to the Flourish Cave, then you can challenge this most worthy rival face to …… well, seems he doesn’t have a face.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/5315a58e199b812a431b81af7c60ada6c2eb5733.jpg[/img]
[i]Hundun is One of the Most Famous Fantastic Beasts in Chinese Myth[/i]


[h2]New game mode: Zhuolu Chess[/h2]
Want to play more Zhuolu Chess? You can play it as much as you want now. As a popular mini-game in Xuan-Yuan Sword VII, Zhuolu Chess is critically acclaimed. Now You can play this fantastic chess game directly in the new Zhuolu Chess game mode, without running a long way to the NPCs scattered around the map.
There are four Titles in Zhuolu Chess: “Novice”, ”Expert”, “Master” and “Grand Master”, the more games you won, the greater title you would achieve.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/c66e943c617610b3ca786f315c8df6f5567f3428.jpg[/img]
[i]Now You Can Play Zhuolu Chess as Much as You want in the New Game Mode[/i]


[h2]New game mode: Arena of Legacy[/h2]

For those who thirst for battle, here comes the Arena of Legacy. The difficulty is always set to Nightmare in the Arena. If that’s not enough, there are 50 floors waiting for you to challenge. You’ll begin your challenge with no companions or any item you acquired from the normal game. It will drive your combat skill to the limit. But don’t worry, you will get some Nightmare Coins after you finish a floor which can be used to buy items or summon the companions to help you go on.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/ffa94a91be390d7282dfbaa8c5927871ea4a3d94.png[/img]
[i] New game mode: Arena of Legacy[/i]

Only the best swordsman can step onto the top of this Arena. If you’re yearning for the most challenging combat, you shouldn’t miss this.

notes.title: A Significant Patch Including New Boss and New Difficulty i
notes.content:
[h2]New Difficulty, New Boss, New Challenge[/h2]

[h3]Nightmare difficulty[/h3]
Feeling a bit too easy playing in Hard difficulty? A new difficulty setting “Nightmare” is in the game. The first thing you will notice in the Nightmare is that the enemy is doing higher damage to you. Also, you will get slower when your stamina is running out, therefore you need to use your stamina more carefully. Last but not least, enemy AI and moveset got improved, now you will get relentless attacks and combos from enemies like it never ends.

[h3]Tundou[/h3]
New Boss: Tundou is coming up. It is a huge monster with a big mouth which can devour anything in front of it. It possesses the element of Earth and will not hold back it’s power against the player. After you beat Tundou, you can imprison it as a new escort like Taowu.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/ccd1cc909fd2de42e386083c4f8b96e81616edd7.jpg[/img]
After defeating Tundou, you can imprison it as a new escort.

[h3]Stun mechanism[/h3]
The good news about Ox and Tiger stance, stunning the enemies is a lot easier with those two stances. You can use them to stun the bosses and execute them for massive damage. Also, there is a huge improvement in parry and counter attack, not only parry will recover your stamina drastically but the counter-attack also stuns the enemies very effectively. Needless to say, it will be handy in Nightmare difficulty.


[h2]Start Your Journey Again with Immortal Sword[/h2]

In Xuan-Yuan Sword Series, the immoral weapon, Xuan-Yuan Sword, is forged by the very first monarch of Ancient China -- the Yellow Emperor. Containing the most powerful energy, this sword is held by the legendary heroine, Wenjin, in Xuan-Yuan Sword VII. 
As patch 1.1 is updated, you’ll be offered an incredible chance to use the immortal Sword. After finishing the whole game at least once, “New Game +” will be unlocked so that you can begin the journey again with this ancient Chinese immortal sword in your hand. What’s more, you can also keep your level, stance, martial art, and some of your items like potion and currency into the new game +.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/be0e5088339772ba5e8eaa05a83f9a2ca2b59b04.jpg[/img]
An incredible chance to use the immortal Sword

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/37efe5f22954f9f97187301c53d09ceff33b0419.jpg[/img]
You can also increasingly upgrade the Xuan-Yuan Sword


[h2]New title soundtrack composed by Yoko Shimomura[/h2]

A new title soundtrack “Mohism” composed by a Japanese famous composer and pianist, Yoko Shimomura, is added. Players are able to choose the title soundtrack between “Mohism”(BGM2) and “the Divine Land”(BGM1) now.


[h2]3 New Supported Languages Coming February 2021[/h2]
In February 2021, there will be 3 new supported languages in Xuan-Yuan Sword VII: Russian, German, and Spanish.

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.content:
[h1]1. Why can't I change to the highest resolution with a 2K/4K screen?[/h1]

Go to Options, Graphics Tab, switch Display Mode to Windowed and you can change the resolution. The resolution of the game is related to your screen resolution setting.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/9ea3764207d07557eaec4e0ce47b3b983d8ec63e.png[/img]

This issue is related to UE4 regulation; we are contacting Epic to solve this issue.

For now, you can solve this issue by readjusting the DPI setting of your OS.
Here we take Win10 for an example to demonstrate how to change the DPI setting.
Settings > System > Display > Scale and layout change to 100% (recommended)


 If you don’t want to change the DPI of your OS, you can only change the DPI setting of the game. Please follow the steps below.
Right-click on the SWD7.EXE file, and check two options in the following pictures.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/9074fe20621b7d1c032c74d77d5030592a37fe1f.png[/img]



[h1]2.	How to activate 30th Anniversary Special Pack[/h1]
You need to download the appearance DLC separately. Please make sure you already download and install the game. And you can go to the store page to download “Xuan-Yuan Sword VII” and download the DLC.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/5c48cc7eecd9c0b2abdbe13fa482b29dae46d2c7.jpg[/img]

Clicking the download button will activate the game.

Go into the game and get the weapon appearance.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/6e6d3241dcb1af8421adf02f263fa536b149e35a.png[/img]



[h1]3.	Where to find DLC “Soundtrack and Artbook” after purchase.[/h1]
[h2]A.	Original soundtrack album[/h2]
After purchasing the soundtrack, you can go to the library page and check “soundtracks”. Then you can download the album.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/229b4dacc58fa20d28d5d290d7cd937938273a92.jpg[/img]
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/d257d44cfa0da8d165da4ddb9279523bc8c15b86.jpg[/img]

Download and play on this page.

[h2]B.	Artbook[/h2]
Along with the soundtrack, the artbook will be downloaded as well.
On the same page, click “Browse Local Files”, then you can find the art collection from the pop-up window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/af8ee594fafef35217b84e47b445c76f312857f8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is Available Now
notes.content:
Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is available now! Players can order it on Steam(worldwide) and PS4(for Asia).
You will take on the role of Taishi Zhao, a calm and reliable swordman. To protect his beloved family, Zhao is going to start a journey in this chaotic realm to find the truth.

[b]Digital Editions on STEAM[/b]
There are Digital Standard Edition and Digital Deluxe Edition on Steam. Deluxe Edition includes Standard Edition, Xuan-Yuan Sword VII Soundtrack, and Artbook. 

PC Exclusive Special Pack	
No matter which edition you ordered, Xuan-Yuan Sword’s 30th anniversary Special Pack will be free to download! This pack can change the appearance of your weapon.

30th Aniversary Special Pack includes：
 Weapon Appearances：
Sealed Sword---Taishi Zhao
World-Shaking Gloves---Taishi Xiang
Xuan-Yuan Cleaver---Chu Hong

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/38045bdea3c76c6ed6ee1e115fe8ec0fc7ac3961.jpg[/img]

Sealed Sword
A peculiar sword holds mysterious and great power. One can fail to grasp its true strength even with master swordsmanship. 

World-Shaking Gloves
A relic left by a mohist. One can obtain unlimited strength while wearing it and shake the world with one strike.

Xuan-Yuan Cleaver
It is said that these cleavers are used when the Yellow Emperor cook by himself. Long for meat and short for vegetables.
You can equip weapons with the Appearance column, to change the appearances of your weapons.


[b]DLC Plans[/b]

For the follow-up content, the current plan will prioritize the expansion of gameplay as the main axis, adding new gameplay modes and BOSS challenges, and expansion of the plot based on the original story is also under consideration in the plan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/13275c37ba4a0281d7ada681566dadebbf76d9b7.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

[h2]A Milestone for Xuan-Yuan Sword[/h2]

This is the first time for Xuan-Yuan Sword to record soundtracks with a real orchestra instead of using MIDI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/797ea4e9a6305aa2f651d10ec53c409ab0be3f8f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/179440c74c6f63322e98219785d539bcaa87fc8b.jpg[/img]
Composer: ShinRay Woo


Xuan-Yuan Sword VII takes place at the end of the Han dynasty and the beginning of the Xin dynasty, which is a very ancient time in China

Combining orchestra and Chinese characterized instruments performance together with unique Chinese instruments, the famous composer, ShinRay Woo, portrays an oriental realm 2000 years ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/b0d1134f661bed12c85ead96958d7bd9e5a7c7d9.jpg[/img]


DOMO studio invited Just Busy Music Studio to record the soundtracks. With deep skills, they played gorgeously, the violins and cellos gave us a soul-stirring performance. It was an enjoyable experience listening to live performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/285faa993be1087a9279f435b7b7bd15ae9cbfae.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/2198e29d5fdf44305df5b2ad1e600b5f70abb2de.jpg[/img]

As a composer for Xuan-Yuan Sword, ShinRay believes that understanding the whole plot is a basic request. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/2198e29d5fdf44305df5b2ad1e600b5f70abb2de.jpg[/img]
ShinRay is telling the synopsis to the orchestra

The game story of this title focuses on the emotions and relationship between Zhao and his baby sister, so Shinray specifically wrote a theme to perform it. The tune of this theme is considerably warm and dreamy, to present the bond of the siblings and the young sister’s romantic feelings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/7d59ecb891064f3fee91e2773b3d9a231cabdb96.jpg[/img]

Since Chu Hong brings me a very obvious and impressive disposition. Her theme is catchy, marked[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/34ab8b70b4dde70f66936a77d01f4bbb14f29d13.jpg[/img].

notes.content:
After the first released trailer of Xuan-Yuan Sword VII, DOMO studio showcased a new trailer along with the upcoming two heroines character information on the Official Website.


[previewyoutube=jP10vqSXUaU;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jP10vqSXUaU&feature=youtu.be[/previewyoutube]

According to the Mohists’ backstory, Mohists have been insisting on preceding admonitions for the past hundreds of years, isolated to the world with their highly advanced technology ---- clockwork machinery. However, after years of war, some Mohism members advocate toward impacting the world with the clockwork killing weapons. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/47a139e50b1941d51414ad9af7d7156de617dedd.jpg[/img]
Taishi Zhao’s Childhood Friend – Hong
	
Chu Hong is a direct and candid heroine with a decisive mind and a gentle heart, who doesn’t pay too much attention to trivial details. As one of the Mohists, Hong bears strong sympathy for vulnerable people and is willing to help them. As a student to her grandfather, Hong follows the Mohism prohibitions closely and agrees that Clockwork technology should be used in a cautious way.


When engaged in a battle, the two heroines will also support players to fight against enemies.
	

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/39f91cbc3c6bda678d5b6589f93084c049433b5a.jpg[/img]
Combat with hostile Gearbeast

During the journey, you will not only encounter incredible creatures, famous historical figures but also witness Chinese clockwork fantasy, explore ancient ruins, and solve puzzles.

Explore the ancient ruins

During this journey, you will not only encounter incredible creatures, famous historical figures but also witness Chinese clockwork fantasy, explore ancient ruins, and solve gear puzzles.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/98207a91fd0b7811c5247250446ec901d4e55aef.jpg[/img]
Fix gear puzzles

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/f5a1910d74530e9a071a4ebffe9e9797a6c6a194.jpg[/img]
Mysterious totem in a chamber

Players can not only use Elysium Scroll to imprison monsters for fusion, but also slow down enemies in few seconds with Elysium Rift. This will make combats more changeable and flexible.

notes.title: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII: Scenery Montage Released
notes.content:
Xuan-Yuan Sword VII released a Scenery Montage within the game environment featured with Chinese style.

 [previewyoutube=4n47hX6LNFk;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4n47hX6LNFk[/previewyoutube]


[h3]Landscapes between Day and Night[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/1e76c8a50e8b2a12f11692c04a8345ce5590d1b1.jpg[/img]

The environment cycle between day and night brings a more realistic game world to players. From mountains with falls and rivers to the villages with peace and joy, players can roam in both natural landscapes and culture.


[h3]Land of Peach Blossom[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/38079f43a6f2cdb461426848880e11577e134816.jpg[/img]

Featured with oriental aesthetic, the land of peach blossom shows a mystery wonderland in Chinese fairytale. Amid forest full of peach blossoms, the lush grass flourishing along with pond and stream, peach petals fall in riotous profusion.


[h3]An exclusive clockwork world[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047233/0145a52b371ed07a7f75b92e27936d508cae4cbe.jpg[/img]

Mohists and their Clockwork technology are one of the most distinguishing features in the Xuan-Yuan Sword series. In this video, we can have a glimpse of the exclusive clockwork world. Luban Ruins, the classic scene in previous games, will be revitalized with a new appearance in 3D
